Unused Exports
fallow/unused-export

Export is never imported

Why it matters
Named exports that are never imported by any other module in the project. Includes both direct exports and re-exports through barrel files. The export may still be used locally within the same file.

Example
export const formatPrice = ... exists in src/money.ts, but no module imports formatPrice.

How to fix
Remove the export or make it file-local. If it is public API, import it from an entry point or add an intentional suppression with context. To treat exported Effect schemas as type contracts, set effect.schemaExportsAsTypes: fallow then reports them as unused types.

Docs: https://fallow.tools/docs/explanations/dead-code/#unused-exports
